title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
english: Escalating conflict between Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed forces in Yemen has forced over 120,000 people to flee their homes. Many refugees are making dangerous journeys across the Red Sea by boat to reach safety in neighboring Djibouti. Families arrive at displacement camps exhausted and with few belongings, driven by the trauma of constant aerial bombardments and fighting.
amharic: በየመን በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በሳውዲ በሚደገፉ ሃይሎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ከ120,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲሰደዱ አድርጓል። ብዙ ስደተኞች ቀይ ባህርን በጀልባ በማቋረጥ ወደ ጅቡቲ ለመድረስ አደገኛ ጉዞ እያደረጉ ነው። ቤተሰቦች በአየር ጥቃት እና በጦርነት ፍርሃት ተገደው አገራቸውን በመልቀቅ በስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፖች ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni Houthisii fi humnoota Sa’udii deggaramanii jidduutti cimaa deemuun namoota kuma dhibba tokko fi kuma digdama ol ta’an godaansisuu isaa ibsameera. Baqattoonni hedduun lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf galaana Diimaa markabaan qaxxaamuruun gara Jibuutii godaanaa jiru. Miidhaa waraanaa fi dhukaasa xiyyaaraa irraa baqachuudhaan, maatiin baqattootaa kun qabeenya isaanii malee kaampiiwwan baqattootaa keessatti haala ulfaataa keessa jiru.

title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
english: A 65-year-old Rwandan man living in London has become the first person charged in the UK in connection with the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Dr. Vincent Brown is accused of inciting and directing acts of murder and genocide following a lengthy seven-year police investigation. This case serves as a warning that the UK will hold individuals accountable for international crimes rather than serving as a refuge for them.
amharic: በለንደን የሚኖር የ65 ዓመት የሩዋንዳዊ ተወላጅ በ1994 በሩዋንዳ በተፈጸመው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ተሳትፈዋል ተብለው በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ክስ የተመሰረተባቸው የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሆነዋል። ዶክተር ቪንሰንት ብራውን የሰባት ዓመት ምርመራ ከተደረገ በኋላ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን በማቀነባበር እና በመምራት ተከስሰዋል። ይህ ክስ ብሪታኒያ ለዓለም አቀፍ ወንጀለኞች መሸሸጊያ እንደማትሆን እና ተጠያቂነትን ለማስፈን ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ያሳያል።
oromo: Namni lammii Ruwaandaa waggaa 65 kan London jiraatu tokko, bara 1994 Ruwaandaatti saba-fixiinsa geggeeffame waliin walqabatee biyya UK keessatti kan himatame nama jalqabaa ta'eera. Doktar Viinsent Biraawun qorannoo waggaa torba fudhateen booda, ajjeechaa fi saba-fixiinsa geggeessuu fi kakaasuun himatameera. Himannaan kunis UK bakka namoonni yakka akkanaa raawwatan itti dhokatan akka hin taane fi seeraan akka itti gaafataman akeekkachiisa.

title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
english: Powerful Typhoon Dujuan has struck Japan, forcing authorities to issue evacuation orders for nearly two million residents due to severe weather risks. The storm caused widespread power outages, transportation cancellations, and the suspension of various public events during a major holiday. While some weather warnings have been downgraded, officials remain concerned about landslide threats and have urged the public to stay cautious.
amharic: ኃይለኛው የዱጁዋን አውሎ ንፋስ ጃፓንን በመምታቱ፣ ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ስጋት ምክንያት ለሁለት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች የለቀቃ ትእዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። አውሎ ንፋሱ በበዓል ወቅት በብዙ አካባቢዎች የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ፣ የበረራ ስረዛ እና የተለያዩ ዝግጅቶች እንዲቋረጡ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የአየር ንብረት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ቢቀነሱም፣ መንግስት የመሬት መንሸራተት ስጋት ስላለ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Dujuan jedhamu biyya Jaappaan rukutuun, balaa cimaa akkasumas akka namoonni miliyoona lama ta'an bakka isaanii gadhiisan dirqisiiseera. Obomboleettiin kun yeroo boqonnaa ummataa keessa waan dhufeef, tajaajilli elektirikii fi geejjibaa addaan citee, akkasumas sagantaaleen garaagaraa akka haqaman ta'eera. Gorsi haala qilleensaa tokko tokko yoo xiqqatayyuu, mootummaan balaa lafa sigigoo fi miidhaa biroo irraa akka of eeggatan ummata gorseera.

title: Protesters blockade Elbit Systems factory over Israel weapons supply
english: A group called 'Silence Elbit Drones' organized a protest at a factory in Staffordshire, UK, to block access to the site. The nine activists chained themselves to equipment to disrupt the company's daily operations. They are demonstrating against Elbit Systems for providing military technology to Israel.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ስታፎርድሻየር የሚገኝ የኤልቢት ሲስተምስ ፋብሪካ በዘጠኝ ተቃዋሚዎች ታገደ። 'ሳይለንስ ኤልቢት ድሮንስ' የተሰኘው ቡድን አባላት ፋብሪካው ለእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎችን በማቅረቡ ተቃውሟቸውን ለመግለጽ በአካባቢው ተሰባስበዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የኩባንያውን የስራ እንቅስቃሴ ለማስተጓጎል ሲባል እራሳቸውን በመሳሪያዎች በመቆለፍ የፋብሪካውን መግቢያ ዘግተው ነበር።
oromo: Hiriirtonni sagalee 'Silence Elbit Drones' jedhamuun beekaman, qindoomina isaanii kanaan magaala Staafordshaayer keessatti warshaa Elbit Systems jedhamu cufanii jiru. Namoonni sagal ta'an kun, warshichi Israa'elitti meeshaa waraanaa dhiyeessuu isaa mormuuf jecha karaa seenu cufaniiru. Gocha kanaanis hojiin warshichaa akka dhaabatuuf ofitti hidhuun hiriira isaanii gaggeessaniiru.

title: Trump’s approval rating hits record low amid Iran war, economy fallout
english: President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to a career-low of 32 percent, primarily due to public frustration over high living costs and the ongoing war with Iran. Support from his own Republican base has significantly declined, with voters expressing deep concern about fuel prices ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. While the President recently signaled hope for an end to the conflict, the administration faces significant political challenges as economic issues continue to dominate voter sentiment.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሕዝብ ድጋፍ በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በአትራን ጦርነት ምክንያት ወደ 32 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል፤ ይህም በፖለቲካ ሕይወታቸው ከተመዘገቡት ዝቅተኛው ነው። የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች በኑሮ ውድነት እና በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ላይ ያላቸው ቅሬታ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ በምርጫው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን ትራምፕ የጦርነቱ ፍጻሜ እንደቀረበ ቢጠቁሙም፣ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮች በአገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ተግዳሮት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan amantii fi degarsi Pirezidaant Doolaard Traamp irraa qaban gara dhibbeentaa 32tti gadi bu'eera; kunis kan ta'e baasii jireenyaa olka'aa fi waraana Iraan waliin taasifamuun walqabatee dha. Deeggarsii miseensota paartii Ripaabilikaanii keessaatti qabanis hir'achaa kan dhufe yoo ta'u, lammiileen gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaatti gaddanii jiru. Traamp waraanni kun xumura irra akka gahe dubbatanii jiranillee, rakkoon dinagdee filannoo dhufu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Photos: Gaza’s children return to class in tents and ruins
english: Hundreds of thousands of students in Gaza have resumed their education for the first time in three years, despite the vast majority of school buildings being destroyed or severely damaged. Classes are now being held in makeshift tents and temporary structures due to the ongoing conflict and extreme shortages of basic supplies like stationery. Despite the loss of many teachers and students, children are returning to these difficult environments with a determination to continue their learning.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች አብዛኛው የትምህርት ቤት ህንጻዎች በመውደማቸው ምክንያት ለሶስት ዓመታት ከተቋረጠ በኋላ ትምህርታቸውን እንደገና ጀምረዋል። በጦርነቱ እና በከባድ የቁሳቁስ እጥረት ምክንያት ትምህርቱ እየተሰጠ ያለው በድንኳኖች እና ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ ነው። ብዙ መምህራን እና ተማሪዎች ቢሞቱም፣ ህጻናቱ ባሉበት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንኳን ትምህርታቸውን ለመቀጠል ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti barattoonni kuma dhibbaan lakkaa'aman mana barumsaa hedduun barbada'uun waggaa sadiif erga addaan citee booda barumsa isaanii itti fufaniiru. Walitti buiinsa ammayyuu jiruufi hanqina meeshaalee barnootaa irraa kan ka'e, barnoonni kan kennamaa jiru dunkaanaafi bakkeewwan yeroo keessatti. Barsiisonnii fi barattoonni hedduun lubbuun isaanii darbus, ijoolleen haala rakkisaa keessa jiran kana keessattiyyuu barachuu itti fufuuf murannoo guddaa agarsiisaniiru.

title: Protesters march on Islamabad over soaring fuel prices
english: The Jamaat-e-Islami party in Pakistan is organizing a protest march to Islamabad to demand the removal of heavy fuel taxes. Authorities have increased security measures in the capital due to the rising public unrest. These demonstrations are occurring alongside separate political tensions involving demands for the release of Imran Khan.
amharic: የፓኪስታኑ ጀማተ እስላሚ ፓርቲ በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ላይ በመቃወም ወደ ኢስላማባድ ሰልፍ እያደረገ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት በከተማዋ የፀጥታ እርምጃዎችን አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ተቃውሞ የኢምራን ካን መፈታትን ከሚጠይቁ ሌሎች የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴዎች ጋር በአንድ ጊዜ እየተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Paartiin Jaamaat-e-Islaamii Paakistaan keessatti gatii boba’aa dabee mormuun gara magaalaa Islaamaabaaditti hiriira bahaniiru. Mootummaan tasgabbii eeguuf jecha magaalaa sana keessatti eegumsa cimaa gochaa jira. Hiriirri kun gaaffii hidhamuu imraan Kaan irraa dhufu waliin wal-qabatee kan godhamaa jiru dha.

title: Ceuta solidarity shirt row: How the crisis engulfed Spanish football
english: A political controversy has emerged in Spanish football after Real Madrid players wore solidarity shirts regarding the migrant crisis in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The move sparked backlash and debate because some fans and officials felt it took sides in the ongoing tensions between Spain and Morocco. While some players intended to show support for both the region and the suffering migrants, others, including La Liga leadership, criticized the players for involving sport in a complex political conflict.
amharic: በስፔን ሴኡታ ግዛት በተከሰተው የስደተኞች ቀውስ ዙሪያ የሪያል ማድሪድ ተጫዋቾች የተቃውሞ እና የድጋፍ መግለጫ የሆኑ ቲ-ሸርቶችን በመልበሳቸው በስፔን እግር ኳስ ውስጥ ውዝግብ ተነስቷል። ይህ ድርጊት በስፔን እና በሞሮኮ መካከል ባለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ውስጥ መግባት ነው በሚል ትችት አስነስቷል። ተጫዋቾቹ ለሴኡታ ነዋሪዎች እና ለተጎዱ ስደተኞች ያላቸውን አጋርነት ለመግለጽ የሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ የላሊጋው ፕሬዚዳንትን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ አካላት ስፖርትን ከፖለቲካ ጋር ማያያዝ ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Taphattoonni Real Madrid godina Ceuta keessatti rakkoo godaantotaa uumame irratti xalayaa deggarsaa qabu uffachuun isaanii ispoortii Ispeen keessatti jeequmsa uumeera. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa kan Ispeen fi Morooko gidduu jiru keessa galuu waan ta'eef mormii guddaa kaaseera. Taphattoonni kun gama tokkoon naannichaaf, gama biraan ammoo godaantota miidhameef deggarsa agarsiisuuf yaalanis, hoogganoonni La Liga fi qaamoleen biroo ispoortii siyaasa keessa galchuu isaanii balaaleffataniiru.

title: US Treasury chief says Iran airlines to be 'shut down' 23 September
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that Iranian airlines will be effectively grounded globally starting September 23 due to new, severe American sanctions. International entities are now prohibited from offering fuel, landing services, or ticket sales to these airlines under threat of being expelled from the US dollar financial system. This action is part of the Trump administration's broader strategy to intensify economic pressure on Tehran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደገለጹት አዲሱ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ ተግባራዊ በሚሆንበት ከመስከረም 12 ቀን ጀምሮ የኢራን አየር መንገዶች በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በረራ ማድረግ ይቸገራሉ። ማናቸውም አለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ለኢራን አውሮፕላኖች ነዳጅ፣ የማረፊያ አገልግሎት ወይም የቲኬት ሽያጭ የሚያቀርቡ ከሆነ ከአሜሪካ ዶላር የገንዘብ ስርዓት እንደሚባረሩ ተገልጿል። ይህ እርምጃ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኢራን ላይ የሚያደርገውን ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና አካል ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Ameerikaa Iskoot Besent akka beeksisanitti, guyyaa Bitootessa 23 irraa eegalee sababa sanadaa haaraa Ameerikaatiin, xiyyaarriin İraan addunyaa guutuu keessatti hojii dhaabuu fi balali'uun isaanirratti akka isaan rakkisu beekameera. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa kamiyyuu xiyyaara İraaniif boba'aa, tajaajila buufachuu, ykn tikkeetii gurguruu akka hin dandeenye kan dubbatame yoo ta'u, kana godhanis sirna maallaqa dolaara Ameerikaa keessaa akka ari'aman akeekkachiifameera. Tarkaanfiin kun tarsiimoo bulchiinsi Traamp İraan irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa gochuuf qabu keessa tokko dha.

title: US refuses visas for Iran UN delegation members
english: The United States government has denied entry visas to several members of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian’s team scheduled to attend the UN General Assembly this week. Iranian state media described this decision as a hostile act, as it specifically impacted the president's communications staff. Despite these travel restrictions, the president is still expected to deliver his scheduled address to the UN on Wednesday.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት በዚህ ሳምንት በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ለመሳተፍ ለታቀደው የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዘሽኪያን ልዑካን ቡድን አባላት የመግቢያ ቪዛ መፍቀድ እንደማትችል አስታውቃለች። የኢራን የመንግሥት ሚዲያዎች ይህንን እርምጃ የፕሬዝዳንቱን የኮሙዩኒኬሽን ቡድን ያካተተ በመሆኑ እንደ ጠላትነት የሚታይ ድርጊት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ምንም እንኳን የጉዞ እገዳው ቢኖርም፣ የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ረቡዕ ዕለት በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅት ንግግር እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa miseensota garee pireezidantii Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan torban kana walgahii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaatti hirmaachuuf turan tokko tokkoof viza akka hin kennine beeksiseera. Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Iraan tarkaanfiin kun garee quunnamtii ummataa pireezidantichaa waan miidheef, akka gocha diinummaatti ilaalamu ibsaniiru. Dhiibbaa deeggarsa viza kanaa keessatti iyyuu, pireezidantichi roobii dhufu walgahii kana irratti haasawa kan taasisan ta'uun gabaafameera.

title: In defence of Israel's Jewish settlers in the West Bank
english: Several Western nations, including the UK, France, and Canada, have recently implemented trade bans on products from Jewish settlements in the West Bank due to rising settler violence and long-standing international legal concerns. While Israel has retaliated with diplomatic restrictions against British officials, critics argue these boycotts are inconsistent because they do not cover all Israeli-controlled territories. The article highlights that these settlements have been considered illegal under international law for decades, raising questions about why these specific actions are being taken now.
amharic: እንደ እንግሊዝ፣ ፈረንሳይ እና ካናዳ ያሉ የምዕራባውያን ሀገራት በተቀመጠኞች የፈጸሙትን የጥቃት ድርጊት ተከትሎ ከዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራዎች የሚመጡ ምርቶች ላይ የንግድ እገዳ ጥለዋል። እስራኤል ለዚህ እርምጃ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ምላሽ የሰጠች ቢሆንም፣ ተቺዎች እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች የተቀሩትን የእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ያሉ አካባቢዎችን ስለማያካትቱ አድልዎ የተሞላባቸው ናቸው ይላሉ። እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች ከአስርተ ዓመታት በፊት በአለም አቀፍ ህግ ህገ-ወጥ መሆናቸው ቢታወቅም፣ አሁን እየተወሰደ ያለው እርምጃ በምን ምክንያት እንደሆነ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Biyyoonni dhihaa akka UK, Faransaay fi Kaanaadaa, haleellaa qonxoota (settlers) irra deddeebi’ee raawwatamu mormuudhaan, oomishaalee naannoo West Bank irraa dhufan irratti daldala dhowwaniiru. Israa’el tarkaanfii kana mormuudhaan jila biyyoota kanneenii irratti dhiibbaa diippilomaasii kan goote yoo ta’u, komatootni garuu tarkaanfichi Israa’el guutummaatti too’attu hunda waan hin hammanneef madaalawaa miti jedhu. Qonxootni kun seera idil-addunyaatiin waggoota hedduuf kan mormaman ta’us, amma maaliif tarkaanfiin kun akka fudhatame gaaffii uumera.

title: Tunisia arrests at least 11 pro-Palestine protesters
english: Tunisian authorities have detained at least 11 individuals following a protest held to demand the release of other pro-Palestinian activists. While lawyers and local groups provided varying estimates on the number of people arrested, officials have yet to confirm an exact count. A judge has ordered a 48-hour extension for the detention of those currently in custody.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ባለሥልጣናት ቀደም ሲል የታሰሩ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊዎችን ለመፍታት በተደረገ ሰልፍ ላይ የተሳተፉ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የታሰሩትን ሰዎች ቁጥር በተመለከተ የሕግ ባለሙያዎች እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች የተለያየ መረጃ ቢሰጡም፣ መንግሥት እስካሁን ይፋዊ ቁጥር አልሰጠም። ዳኛው የታሰሩት ሰዎች የእስር ጊዜ በ48 ሰዓታት እንዲራዘም ውሳኔ አሳልፈዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Tunisiyaa namoota yoo xiqqaate 11 ta'an, duula deggarsa Filisxeemii geggeessaa turanifi isaan dura hidhaman hiiki jechuun hiriira bahaniin hidhatti guuraniiru. Lakkoofsa namoota hidhaman irratti giddiramee fi abukaatonni yoo ta'u, mootummaan hanga ammaatti lakkoofsa sirrii hin ibsine. Abbaan seeraa tokko namoota hidhaman kanaaf guyyaa 48 itti dabaluun akka hidhamanii turan ajajeera.

title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has pledged to maintain his governing coalition despite suffering significant losses in recent state elections. While his party faces pressure due to rising support for the far-right Alternative for Germany party, Merz insists that staying in office is vital for the nation's democratic stability. He dismissed claims that his personal unpopularity is the primary reason for these political setbacks.
amharic: የጀርመኑ ቻንስለር ፍሬድሪች መርዝ በቅርቡ በተካሄዱ የክልል ምርጫዎች ፓርቲያቸው የደረሰበትን ከባድ ሽንፈት ተከትሎ፣ የመንግስት ጥምረቱን ለማስቀጠል ቃል ገብተዋል። በጽንፈኛ ቀኝ አራማጅ ፓርቲዎች እያደገ የመጣው ተጽዕኖ እና የፓርቲያቸው ድክመት ጫና ቢፈጥርበትም፣ መርዝ የአገሪቱን ዲሞክራሲያዊ የወደፊት ሁኔታ ለማረጋገጥ ስልጣን ላይ እንደሚቆዩ ተናግረዋል። የሽንፈቱ ዋና መንስኤ የእርሳቸው ተወዳጅነት ማጣት ነው የሚለውን መከራከሪያም ውድቅ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Mummee Jarman Firidriich Merz, filannoo naannolee darbe irratti injifatannoo guddaa erga dhabanii booda, kutaalee mootummaa walitti fufsiisuuf akka hojjetan beeksisan. Paartiin isaanii kaayyoo siyaasaa gara mirgaatti qabatu irraa dhiibbaa cimaa irratti darbaa jiruus, Merz nageenya dimokiraasii biyyattii eeguuf jedhanii aangoo irra turuuf murteessaniiru. Isaanis, dadhabinni paartichaa kan dhufe beekamtii dhabuu kiyya irraa miti jechuun himannaa dhihaate mormaniiru.

title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico to file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
english: CNN, Politico, and MS NOW are taking legal action against the Trump administration after their journalists were denied access to the White House. The president imposed this ban due to his dissatisfaction with their reporting, which he labeled as dishonest. The media organizations argue that this restriction violates their First Amendment rights and undermines the principle of a press free from government control.
amharic: ሲኤንኤን፣ ፖለቲኮ እና ኤምኤስ ናው ጋዜጠኞቻቸው ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ እንዳይገቡ በመከልከላቸው በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ክስ ለመመስረት ወስነዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እርምጃውን የወሰዱት ሚዲያዎቹ ሀሰተኛ መረጃዎችን ያሰራጫሉ በሚል ነው። የዜና ተቋማቱ በበኩላቸው ይህ ድርጊት የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጥስ እና በመንግስት ጣልቃ ገብነት ነፃ ጋዜጠኝነትን የሚያዳክም ነው ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል።
oromo: CNN, Politico fi MS NOW gaazexeessitoonni isaanii gamoo White House akka hin seenne dhorkamuun isaanii booda, mootummaa Trump irratti himata banuuf murteessaniiru. Preezidaanti Trump tarkaanfich kan fudhatan gabaasi miidiyaalee kunneenii soba jedhanii amanuun isaaniitiin. Dhaabbileen miidiyaa kunneen gama isaaniitiin, gochi kun mirga bilisummaa miidiyaa kan sarbuufi mootummaan gabaasa miidiyaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance
english: Seven Ethiopian rebel factions, including the TPLF, OLA, and Fano, have united to form the Alliance for Survival with the goal of replacing the current government. These groups, representing half of the country's regions, blame Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's administration for ongoing instability, economic hardship, and violence. Despite past conflicts between some of these groups, they have agreed to set aside their differences to oppose the federal authorities.
amharic: እንደ ህወሓት፣ የኦሮሞ ነፃነት ሰራዊት እና ፋኖ ያሉ ሰባት የኢትዮጵያ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች መንግስትን ለመለወጥ ዓላማ ያለው «የህልውና ጥምረት» የተሰኘ አዲስ ስብስብ መስርተዋል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች የአብይ አህመድን አስተዳደር በሀገሪቱ ለሚፈጠሩ ግጭቶች፣ ድህነት እና አለመረጋጋት ተጠያቂ ያደርጋሉ። ከዚህ በፊት እርስ በእርስ ሲጋጩ የነበሩት እነዚህ ቡድኖች አሁን የጋራ ጠላታቸውን ለመጋፈጥ ልዩነታቸውን ወደ ጎን ትተው በአንድነት ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: gareen finxaaleyyii Itoophiyaa torba, kanneen akka TPLF, WBO fi Faannoo mootummaa amma jiru fonqolchuuf 'Gamtaa Hanqina Oolmaa' (Alliance for Survival) jedhu tokko ta'aniiru. Gareewwan kun mootummaa Abiy Ahimad rakkoolee biyyattii keessatti mul'atan, hiyyummaa fi waraanaaf itti gaafatamtoota jedhu. Gareewwan kun darbee darbee waliin wal waraanaa kan turan ta'us, amma garuu mootummaa dura dhaabbachuuf garaagarummaa isaanii dagatanii tokko ta'uuf murteessaniiru.

title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
english: A UN report states that US military airstrikes against suspected drug-trafficking boats in the Caribbean and Pacific may violate international law. The report notes that these strikes have killed over 220 people and lack sufficient justification under self-defense or counter-terrorism frameworks. Consequently, the UN official suggested that these repeated actions could be classified as crimes against humanity.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ አሜሪካ በካሪቢያን እና በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ በአደንዛዥ እፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች ላይ የምታደርሳቸው የአየር ጥቃቶች አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ ናቸው። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከ220 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደሉ ሲሆን፣ በራስ መከላከል ወይም በአሸባሪነት መከላከል ሰበብ ሊጸድቁ እንደማይችሉ ተገልጿል። በሪፖርቱ መሰረት፣ በተደጋጋሚ የሚፈጸሙት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሰው ልጅን የሚቃወሙ ወንጀሎች ሊባሉ እንደሚችሉ ተመላክቷል።

title: Egypt’s Amina Orfi becomes youngest women’s squash world number one at 19
english: Nineteen-year-old Egyptian squash star Amina Orfi has made history as the youngest women’s world number one ever. She secured the top spot after defeating Hania El Hammamy to win the Qatar Classic. Orfi currently holds both the senior and junior world titles, marking a record-breaking year for the young athlete.
amharic: የ19 ዓመቷ ግብጻዊት የስኳሽ ተጫዋች አሚና ኦርፊ በታሪክ ትንሿ የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ሴት በመሆን አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግባለች። ይህንን ደረጃ ማግኘት የቻለችው በኳታር ክላሲክ ፍጻሜ ሀኒያ ኤል ሀማሚን በማሸነፍ ነው። ኦርፊ በአሁኑ ወቅት የዓለም የከፍተኛ እና የወጣቶች ሻምፒዮናን በአንድ ላይ የያዘች ሲሆን፣ በስፖርት ህይወቷ አስደናቂ ዓመት እያሳለፈች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Taphattuun isquwaashii lammii Gibxii kan taate Amina Orfi umuriin ishee waggaa 19, sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa irratti argamtee seenaa haaraa galchiteetti. Sadarkaa kana kan gonfatte tapha Qataar Kilaasikii injifachuudhaan yoo ta'u, kana dura sadarkaa tokkoffaa irra kan turte Haniiyaa El Hamaamii mo'atteetti. Amina yeroo ammaa qophii addunyaa kan gurguddaas ta'e kan dargaggootaa harka ishee kan qabdu yoo ta'u, waggaa kana injifannoo guddaa galmeessiteetti.

title: Inside Kazakhstan’s push to become a regional AI centre
english: Kazakhstan is prioritizing artificial intelligence as a core strategy to modernize its economy, reduce its dependence on natural resources, and improve government efficiency. The government has established a dedicated ministry, passed comprehensive AI regulations, and launched educational initiatives to train citizens in new digital skills. While these advancements aim to drive growth, critics are concerned about the potential negative effects of rapid AI adoption on human rights and the environment.

oromo: Kaazaakhistaan diinagdee ishee ammayyeessuuf, qabeenya uumamaa irratti hirkattummaa xiqqeessuuf, akkasumas tajaajila mootummaa fooyyessuuf teknooloojii 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa kennite jirti. Mootummaan ministeera mataa isaa ta'e hundeessuun, seera ittiin bulmaataa baasuu fi lammiilee dandeettii dijitaalaatiin leenjisuuf sagantaalee barnootaa garaagaraa eegaleera. title: Swiss captain Xhaka sidelined over fake COVID-19 vaccination certificate
english: Swiss national team captain Granit Xhaka has been dropped from the upcoming international squad after admitting he obtained a fraudulent COVID-19 vaccination certificate. Xhaka publicly apologized for the error and is cooperating with authorities as he faces the consequences of his actions. The Swiss Football Association decided it was best for the team to continue their current training camp without him, with a review of his status to follow once the matches are over.

oromo: Kabtaan garee biyyoolessa Siwiizerland Granit Xhaka, ragaa talaallii COVID-19 sobaa fudhachuu isaa erga amanee booda, taphoota idil-addunyaa dhufan irraa akka hir’atu murtaa’eera. Xhaka gocha isaa kanaaf dhiifama gaafachaa fi qaamota seeraa waliin hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, gochi isaa akka dogoggoraatti fudhateera. Waldaan kubbaa miillaa Siwiizerland, gareen kun nagaadhaan taphoota isaa akka geggeeffatuuf, Xhaka yeroo ammaa garee sana irraa akka adda ba’u murteessera; gara fuulduraattis haala isaa irratti marii ni taasisu.

title: Who is Yu Zidi, China’s 13-year-old swimming sensation?
english: Thirteen-year-old Chinese swimmer Yu Zidi has become a standout star at the Asian Games by setting a new Asian record in the 200m individual medley. This gold medal victory follows her success in the 200m butterfly just one day prior. Having gained recognition as a young prodigy after medaling at the World Championships at age 12, she is now considered one of the sport's top rising talents.

title: ‘Britain can stop this’: The East Jerusalem yeshiva taking UK charity money and planning expansion
english: The ultra-Orthodox institution Ohr Somayach, which recruits students from Western countries, has received official approval to build a large 11-story campus in the Sheikh Jarrah neighborhood of East Jerusalem. This project, which has faced years of local opposition, is situated on land considered occupied territory under international law. Concerns have been raised regarding the institution's expansion plans, specifically highlighting its receipt of funding from British charities.

title: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen’s Taiz as Houthi forces advance
english: A Saudi-led coalition launched an airstrike in Yemen's Taiz province as Houthi rebels continue to gain ground along the Red Sea coast. The Houthis are currently moving toward the strategically significant Bab al-Mandeb Strait.

title: Erdogan and Burnham to meet for first time at UN General Assembly in New York
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan is set to hold his first meeting with new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham during the United Nations General Assembly in New York. The two leaders aim to build upon the strong security and defense partnership recently established between their nations. Erdogan also plans to engage in various other high-level diplomatic meetings with several global heads of state during his visit.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶጋን በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ከብሪታንያው አዲስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ ቡርንሃም ጋር ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ይገናኛሉ። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በቅርቡ በሀገራቱ መካከል የተመሰረተውን ጠንካራ የደህንነት እና የመከላከያ አጋርነት ይበልጥ ለማጠናከር ይወያያሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ፕሬዝዳንት ኤርዶጋን ከሌሎች የተለያዩ ሀገራት መሪዎች ጋርም ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶችን ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Xayib Erdogaan magaalaa Niiw Yoorkitti gumiin waliigalaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii yeroo gaggeeffamutti, muummee ministiraa Biriitaaniyaa haaraa Aan Dii Burnaam waliin yeroo jalqabaaf wal arguuf qophaa’aniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen biyyoota lamaan gidduutti hariiroo nageenyaa fi ittisaa ammaan dura uumame cimsuuf mari’atu jedhamee eeggama. Yeroo daawwannaa isaanii kanatti, Pireezidaanti Erdogaan hoggantoota biyyoota addunyaa biroo waliinis marii diippilomaasii olaanaa kan gaggeessan ta’a.

title: Ethiopia’s Future Demands Axum–Harar Synergy
english: Ethiopian civilization was shaped by the parallel development of two distinct yet complementary historical centers: the Christian-focused northern Axum and the Islamic-influenced eastern Harar. While Axum represents the country's ancient imperial and architectural roots, Harar serves as a vital hub for trade, scholarship, and urban culture. Recognizing both traditions, alongside the contributions of various other ethnic groups, provides a more comprehensive understanding of Ethiopia's rich and diverse heritage.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ስልጣኔ በሰሜኑ የአክሱም ክርስትና ተኮር እና በምስራቁ የሐረር እስላማዊ ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ ማዕከላት ጥምረት የተገነባ ነው። አክሱም የሀገሪቱን የጥንታዊ ንጉሳዊ እና የስነ-ህንፃ መሰረት ሲወክል፣ ሐረር ደግሞ ለንግድ፣ ለትምህርት እና ለከተማ ባህል ትልቅ አስተዋፅዖ አበርክቷል። እነዚህን ሁለት ታሪካዊ ጎዳናዎች ከሌሎች የኢትዮጵያ ብሔረሰቦች አስተዋፅዖ ጋር አጣምሮ መመልከት የሀገሪቱን ሰፊ እና የተለያየ ታሪክ በተሻለ ሁኔታ ለመረዳት ያስችላል።
oromo: Siivilizeeshini Itoophiyaa guddina iddoo seenaa lama kan akka Aksumii fi Hararii kan wal cinaa deemaniin kan ijaarame dha. Aksum madda mootummaa fi ijaarsa durii bakka bu'u yoo ta'u, Harar immoo daldala, barnootaa fi aadaa magaalaa irratti gahee guddaa qaba. Aadaa fi seenaa lamaan kana, akkasumas gumaata sabaa fi sablammoota biroo waliin walitti qabanii ilaaluun, seenaa Itoophiyaa kan bal'aa fi miidhagaa ta'e akka gaariitti hubachuuf gargaara.

title: Mourinho fumes at referees in news conference after Madrid derby defeat
english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho expressed strong frustration with refereeing decisions following his team's 2-1 loss to Atletico Madrid. He displayed photographic evidence of two aggressive tackles against his players that he felt deserved red cards, arguing that the officials failed to control the match. Additionally, he criticized the choice of an inexperienced referee for such a high-pressure derby, claiming the officiating negatively impacted the outcome.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አሰልጣኝ ሆዜ ሞሪንሆ ከአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ጋር ባደረጉት የ2-1 ሽንፈት የዳኞችን ውሳኔ በቁጣ ተቃውመዋል። አሰልጣኙ በቡድኑ ተጫዋቾች ላይ የተፈጸሙ እና ቀይ ካርድ ሊያስገኙ የሚገቡ ሁለት አደገኛ ጥፋቶችን የሚያሳዩ ምስሎችን በማቅረብ ዳኞቹ ጨዋታውን መቆጣጠር እንዳልቻሉ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ለእንደዚህ አይነት ከፍተኛ ጫና ባለበት የከተማ ደርቢ ልምድ የሌለው ዳኛ መመደቡን በመተቸት፣ የዳኝነት ውሳኔው በውጤቱ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዳሳደረ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Riyaal Maadriid Josee Moriinhoo erga gareen isaanii Atleetikoo Maadriiditti 2-1 injifatamee booda murtee abbootii firdii irratti aarii guddaa ibsaniiru. Taphattoota isaanii irratti gochaa hamaa raawwatamee fi kaardii diimaa argachuu qabu ture jedhan lama ragaa suuraan deeggaruun dhiheessuun, abbootiin firdii taphicha to'achuu hin dandeenye jechuun himatan. Kana malees, qormaatni guddaa jiruufi tapha akkanaa irratti abbaa firdii muuxannoo hin qabne ramadamuun isaanii sirrii miti jechuun, murteen abbootii firdii bu'aa taphichaa irratti dhiibbaa geessiseera jedhaniiru.

title: Who actually has power at the United Nations?
english: Although all nations have a vote at the United Nations, real decision-making power is concentrated among five specific countries that hold veto authority within the Security Council. This unique privilege allows these permanent members to block resolutions, regardless of global consensus. Consequently, the UN's operational effectiveness is heavily influenced by the political leverage, funding, and strategic interests of these powerful states.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አባል ሀገራት ሁሉ ድምጽ የመስጠት መብት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ትክክለኛው የአመራር ስልጣን ግን በተባበሩት መንግስታት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት ውስጥ የቪቶ መብት ባላቸው አምስት ሀገራት እጅ ነው። ይህ ልዩ ስልጣን እነዚህ ቋሚ አባላት አለም አቀፍ ስምምነት ቢኖርም እንኳ ማንኛውንም ውሳኔ እንዲያግዱ ያስችላቸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት የድርጅቱ አቅምና አሰራር በእነዚህ ሀያል መንግስታት የገንዘብ አቅም፣ የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖ እና ስልታዊ ፍላጎቶች ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው።
oromo: Mootummoonni hundinuu Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii keessatti sagalee kennuuf mirga qabaatanis, aangoon murtii dhugaa harka biyyoota shan qofa kan jiru yoo ta'u, isaanis Mana Maree Nageenyaa keessatti mirga 'veto' qabu. Mirgi addaa kun biyyoota miseensota dhaabbataa ta'an kana, yaada ummata addunyaa hunda bira darbee murtiiwwan akka itti fufan ykn akka dhaabbatan gochuuf isaaniif carraa kenna. Kanaafuu, hojiin dhaabbatichaa baay'inaan dhiibbaa siyaasaa, qabeenyaa fi fedhii biyyoota aangoo qaban kanaan kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Meloni promises to ban burqas, niqabs in Italy’s schools
english: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has announced plans to prohibit students from wearing the niqab and burqa in schools. Additionally, the government aims to limit the number of international students allowed in each classroom. These policy proposals are viewed as efforts to gain political support leading up to the upcoming national elections.
amharic: የጣሊያን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጆርጂያ ሜሎኒ ተማሪዎች በትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ ቡርቃ እና ነቃብ እንዳይለብሱ ለመከልከል አቅደዋል። መንግሥት በክፍል ውስጥ የሚማሩ የውጭ ሀገር ተማሪዎችን ቁጥር ለመገደብም አቅዷል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በሚቀጥለው ዓመት በሚካሄደው ምርጫ የህዝብ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት የታለሙ እንደሆኑ ይነገራል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Xaaliyaan Joorjiyaa Meloonii, barattoonni mana barumsaa keessatti burqaa fi niqaab akka hin uffanne dhowwuuf karoorfataniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan barattoota biyya alaatii kutaa tokko keessatti argaman irratti daangaa kaa'uuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfileen kunneen filannoo dhufuuf jedhamuun dura deggarsa siyaasaa argachuuf kan qopha'anidha.

title: Iran’s military says US preparing to resume strikes
english: Iran's military command has warned of potential new US strikes, threatening retaliation against American interests and regional allies if they facilitate such attacks. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump is currently evaluating various options, including further military action or potential negotiations with Iranian leadership. As high-level diplomatic efforts led by Qatar continue, Tehran maintains that any new talks depend on the end of US hostilities and the removal of economic blockades.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ዕዝ አሜሪካ አዲስ ጥቃት ልትሰነዝር እንደምትችል ማስጠንቀቂያ የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ እንዲህ አይነት ጥቃቶችን የሚደግፉ የክልሉ አገራትም አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ሊወሰድባቸው እንደሚችል አስታውቋል። የዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው ወታደራዊ እርምጃን ወይም ድርድርን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ አማራጮች ላይ እየመከሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በኳታር አደራዳሪነት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ የኢራን መንግሥት ንግግሮች እንዲቀጥሉ የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች እና የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች መቆም አለባቸው የሚል አቋም አለው።
oromo: Ajajni waraana Iraan akka jedhutti, Ameerikaan haleellaa haaraa banuuf qophaa'aa jirti; akkasumas biyyoonni naannichaa haleellaa kana deeggiran tarkaanfii fudhatamuuf akka saaxilaman akeekkachiiseera. Gamtaan, prezidaantiin Ameerikaa Donald Trump tarkaanfii waraanaa dabalatee haala irratti mari'achaa jiru. Kattaar giddu-galeessa ta'uun mariin nageenyaa akka milkaa'u yaalii gochaa jirtus, Iraan mariin kun akka itti fufuuf duraan haleellaa fi uggurri diinagdee Ameerikaa akka dhaabbatu gaafachaa jirti.

title: Massive explosions at Syrian army weapons depot near Aleppo
english: A major explosion occurred at a Syrian military munitions storage facility located south of Aleppo. At least four individuals were wounded in the incident, and ongoing blasts from stored weaponry have made emergency response efforts difficult. Local authorities have shut down surrounding roads to ensure public safety as the situation remains dangerous.
amharic: ከአሌፖ በስተደቡብ በሚገኝ የሶሪያ ጦር የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻ ጣቢያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ ተከስቷል። በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ የጦር መሳሪያዎቹ እየፈነዱ በመሆናቸው የነፍስ አድን ስራው ፈታኝ ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው የሚገኙ መንገዶችን በመዝጋት የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buufata meeshaa waraanaa kan mootummaa Sooriyaa magaalaa Aleppoo gadiin argamutti dhukaatii guddaan tokko mudateera. Balaa kanaan namoonni afur madaa'aniiru; meeshaaleen waraanaa keessatti kuufaman itti fufanii dhuka'aa waan jiraniif hojiin fayyisuu ulfaataa ta'eera. Aangeyyoonni naannichaa nageenya ummataa eeguuf jecha daandiiwwan gurguddoo cufaniiru.

title: IRGC warns of 'significant changes' if US launches fresh attacks
english: A spokesperson for Iran’s Revolutionary Guard warned that any new U.S. military strikes would trigger major shifts in Tehran’s response strategy. Officials stated that they are prepared to use different weapons and target new locations to surprise the international community. This move aims to significantly alter the scope and nature of the conflict should hostilities escalate.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ቃል አቀባይ እንደተናገሩት፣ አሜሪካ በአገሪቱ ላይ አዲስ ጥቃት ከፈጸመች በቴህራን ምላሽ ስልቶች ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ እንደሚኖር አስጠንቅቀዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ዓለምን የሚያስደንቁ አዳዲስ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን ለመጠቀም እና ከዚህ ቀደም ያልተነኩ ኢላማዎችን ለመምታት መዘጋጀታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ግጭቱ ቢቀሰቀስ የጦርነቱን ተፈጥሮ እና ስፋት በእጅጉ እንደሚቀይር ታሳቢ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Irans, kan 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' jedhamu, yoo Ameerikaan miidhaa haaraa isaan irraan geessise, Teheraan deebii ishee irratti jijjiirama guddaa akka gootu akeekkachiiseera. Hoji gaggeessitoonni kun meeshaalee waraanaa haaraa fi iddoowwan duraan hin rukutamne akka xiyyeeffannoo keessa galchan beeksisaniiru. Kunis, yoo waraanni itti fufe, haala fi bal'ina waraanichaa guutummaatti jijjiiruuf akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: IRGC says it downed another US MQ-1 drone over Hormuz Strait
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claims to have successfully shot down a second American MQ-1 drone near the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials state that their newly deployed aerospace defense technology is being used to target these surveillance aircraft. This incident follows claims that Iran has been actively hunting US drones in the region.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አቅራቢያ ሌላ የአሜሪካ የMQ-1 ድሮን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት አዲሱ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓታቸው የአሜሪካን የክትትል አውሮፕላኖች ለመቆጣጠር ጥቅም ላይ እየዋለ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት ኢራን በአካባቢው ያሉ የአሜሪካ ድሮኖችን ለማደን እየሰራች መሆኗን ካረጋገጠች በኋላ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Humnooniin Eegumsa Islaamaa kan Iraan, xiyyaara sarara alaa (dronii) kan Ameerikaa MQ-1 jedhamu tokko naannoo Hormuzitti gadi buusuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Aantoonni Iraan akka jedhanitti, sirni ittisa qilleensaa haaraan isaan fayyadamaa jiran kun xiyyaarota ammayyaa kana to'achuuf gargaaraa jira. Ta'een kun hordofee, Iraan xiyyaarota Ameerikaa naannichatti argaman hordofaa fi rukutaa akka jirtu beekameera.

title: Watch: Francesca Albanese on Macklemore, Miliband and the road to beating Apartheid in Israel
english: UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese recently discussed the shifting global conversation regarding Israel's policies. She addressed controversies involving music artists and the United Kingdom's approach to West Bank settlements. Ultimately, she emphasized the importance of fostering international solidarity to effectively challenge the system of apartheid in the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ልዩ ዘጋቢ ፍራንቼስካ አልባኒዝ በእስራኤል ፖሊሲዎች ዙሪያ እየተለወጠ የመጣውን ዓለም አቀፍ አቋም ተወያይተዋል። በሙዚቃ አርቲስቶች የተፈጠሩ አለመግባባቶችን እና የእንግሊዝ መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራ ላይ የወሰዳቸውን እርምጃዎች ዳስሰዋል። በመጨረሻም በአካባቢው ያለውን የአፓርታይድ ስርዓት ለመታገል ዓለም አቀፍ ትብብር ወሳኝ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Gabaastuun addaa kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Francesca Albanese, yaada idil-addunyaa waa'ee siyaasa Israa'el irratti jijjiiramaa jiru irratti mari'atteetti. Innis wal-dhabdee fannoo muuziqaa fi tarkaanfii mootummaan Ingiliz manneen jireenyaa naannoo West Bank irratti fudhate kan dabalatudha. Dhumarrattis, sirna waldhibdee (apartheid) naannichatti jiru cabsuuf walta'iinsi idil-addunyaa murteessaa ta'uu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Trump administration readies sweeping sanctions against ICC, reports say
english: The Trump administration is planning to impose broad sanctions on the International Criminal Court, moving beyond individual targets to restrict the entire institution's operations. These measures would prevent American companies and citizens from providing financial or logistical support, which could severely hinder the court's ability to conduct investigations and process payments. While the U.S. has previously targeted specific ICC officials, this escalation aims to fundamentally disrupt the tribunal's core functions and international proceedings.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ ሰፊ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካውያን ኩባንያዎችና ግለሰቦች ለፍርድ ቤቱ የገንዘብም ሆነ የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ እንዳይሰጡ የሚያግድ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የፍርድ ቤቱን መደበኛ የሥራ እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ ሊያስተጓጉል ይችላል። ከዚህ ቀደም በተወሰኑ የፍርድ ቤቱ ባለሥልጣናት ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ማዕቀቦች ቢኖሩም፣ አዲሱ ዕቅድ በቀጥታ የተቋሙን አሠራር ላይ በማነጣጠር የምርመራ ሥራዎችን ለማደናቀፍ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Donald Trump mana murtii yakka addunyaa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbatichi gargaarsa maallaqaa fi teeknikaa akka hin arganne dhowwuun, hojii isaa isa guyyuu fi qorannoowwan adda addaa gufachiisuu danda'a. Kanaan dura namoota dhuunfaa irratti xiyyeeffatamaa kan ture yoo ta'u, amma garuu dhaabbaticha guutummaatti duubatti deebisuuf yaadamee kan murtaa'e dha.

title: The Sahel and the UN: a smaller footprint, a different role
english: Following the withdrawal of its major peacekeeping mission in Mali, the United Nations is shifting its approach in the Sahel region toward diplomacy and humanitarian support. Countries like Mali, Niger, and Burkina Faso are prioritizing national sovereignty and have formed their own alliance, which limits the influence of traditional external bodies. The UN now focuses on mediation and development efforts while navigating a complex political environment where regional governments prefer to manage their own security affairs.
amharic: በማሊ የነበረው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ተልዕኮ ካበቃ በኋላ፣ ድርጅቱ በሳህል ክልል ያለውን ተሳትፎ በዲፕሎማሲ እና በሰብዓዊ ድጋፍ ላይ ለማተኮር ቀይሯል። ማሊ፣ ኒጀር እና ቡርኪና ፋሶ የሀገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት በማስቀደም የራሳቸውን ህብረት በመመስረታቸው የውጭ ተቋማት ተፅዕኖ ቀንሷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የክልሉ መንግስታት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት በራሳቸው ለመምራት በሚፈልጉበት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሆኖ፣ በሽምግልና እና በልማት ስራዎች ላይ ብቻ ትኩረት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Miseensota nageenya eegduu UN kan Maali keessa ture erga bahee booda, dhaabbatichi naannoo Sahel keessatti hojiisaa gara dippilomaasii fi gargaarsa namoomeetti jijjiireera. Biyyonni akka Maali, Niijer fi Burkina Faso bilisummaa isaanii dursuun walta'iinsa ofii isaanii ijaarrataniiru; kunis dhiibbaa dhaabbilee alaa hir'iseera. Yeroo ammaa, mootummoonni naannichaa nageenya isaanii ofiin bulchuuf waan murteessaniif, UN gamtaan kun fedhii isaanii kabajaa hojii giddu-galaummaa fi misoomaarratti xiyyeeffachaa jira.

title: Ethiopian armed groups forge alliance against government
english: Seven Ethiopian armed groups, including the TPLF, Fano, and OLA, have formed a new coalition called the Alliance for Survival to challenge Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. This move follows years of separate internal conflicts and growing concerns over national instability and the erosion of democratic reforms. The alliance plans to work together to remove the current administration and establish an inclusive transitional government to lead the country through a peaceful reconciliation process.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሰባት ታጣቂ ቡድኖች የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አቢይ አህመድን መንግስት ለመቃወም 'ለህልውና የሚደረግ ጥምረት' በሚል ስያሜ አዲስ ጥምረት ፈጥረዋል። በቅርቡ የተመሰረተው ይህ ጥምረት፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ ልዩነቶቻቸውን በመተው አሁን ያለውን አስተዳደር በመተካት ሁሉን አቀፍ የሽግግር መንግስት ለማቋቋም ግብ ይዟል። ይህ እርምጃ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው የጸጥታ መደፍረስና የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: gareewwan hidhatan Itoophiyaa torba ta’an, kanneen akka TPLF, Fano fi WBO, mootummaa Muummee Ministiraa Abiy Ahimad fonqolchuuf 'Gamtaaa Oromoo fi Saboota Itoophiyaa' jedhu ijaaraniiru. Gareewwan kunneen kanaan dura wal dhabdee turan cinaatti dhiisuun, mootummaa ammaa aangoo irraa kaasuuf fi mootummaa cehumsaa hundameessuuf waldhiyeessuun hojjechaa jiru. tarkaanfiin kun biyyatti keessatti rakkoolee nageenyaa fi siyaasaa dabalaa jiru gidduutti kan dhufedha.

title: Iran war live: Tehran warns US against new strikes; fighting rages in Yemen
english: Tensions between Iran and the United States have intensified after Tehran warned of severe retaliation if the US conducts further military strikes. President Donald Trump has stated that his administration is considering options ranging from complete military destruction to economic pressure or potential diplomatic negotiations. Meanwhile, ongoing regional conflict continues as violence persists in Yemen.

oromo: Iraan fi Amerikaa gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi cimaa jiraachuun kan ibsame yoo ta’u, Iraan yoo Amerikaan haleellaa biraa raawwatte tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf akka qophoofte akeekkachiisteetti. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru daran hammaatee itti fufee jira.

title: ICE officer shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas, officials say
english: A 28-year-old Venezuelan man named Wilber Rafael Garces Perez was hospitalized in stable condition after being shot in the torso by a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in Austin, Texas. Local police confirmed they were not involved in the incident, which occurred during a traffic stop. Austin's mayor has called for an independent investigation into the shooting to ensure transparency and public safety.
amharic: ዊልበር ራፋኤል ጋርሴስ ፔሬዝ የተባለ የ28 ዓመት የቬንዙዌላ ዜጋ በአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ባለስልጣን (ICE) በተተኮሰበት ጥይት ሆስፒታል ገብቷል። የኦስቲን ፖሊስ እንደገለጸው ጥይቱ የተተኮሰው በትራፊክ ቁጥጥር ወቅት ሲሆን፣ የአካባቢው የፖሊስ ሃይል በድርጊቱ ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ተሳትፎ አልነበረውም። የኦስቲን ከንቲባ ጉዳዩ በገለልተኛ አካል ተጣርቶ ግልጽነት እንዲሰፍን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Dargaggeessi lammii Veenzuweelaa kan waggaa 28 Wilber Rafael Garces Perez jedhamu, magaalaa Austin keessatti ajajaan godansaafi gumuruka (ICE) tokkoon erga dhukaasameef booda hospitaala seeneera. Poolisiin naannichaa akka ibsetti, namichi kan dhukaasame dhaabbii tiraafikaa gidduutti yoo ta'u, poolisoonni magaalaa Austin garuu tarkaanficharratti hirmaannaa hin qaban. Kantiibaan magaalattii qorannoon dhimmichaa akka ifatti gaggeeffamuuf gaafataniiru.

title: Polls close in Russian wartime election with ruling party set to dominate
english: Voting has concluded in Russia's first parliamentary elections since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, with President Putin's ruling party expected to retain control. While the Kremlin intended the election to demonstrate public backing for the war, the process was marked by significant drone attacks from Ukraine and widespread international condemnation for holding votes in occupied regions. Authorities reported a turnout of roughly 57 percent, though officials in Kyiv and the European Union have declared the election in annexed territories illegal.
amharic: ሩሲያ ዩክሬንን ከወረረች በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ያካሄደችው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ተጠናቋል፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲን የሚመራው ገዢ ፓርቲም እንደሚያሸንፍ ይጠበቃል። ክሬምሊን ምርጫውን ለጦርነቱ ያለውን የህዝብ ድጋፍ ማሳያ ለማድረግ ቢሞክርም፣ በምርጫው ወቅት በዩክሬን በኩል መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። በአውሮፓ ህብረት እና በኪዬቭ አስተዳደር ምርጫው በተያዙ የዩክሬን ግዛቶች መካሄዱ ህገ-ወጥ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Rusiyan erga waraana Yukreenii eegalte booda filannoon paarlaamaa ishee jalqabaa xumurameera, kutaaleen bulchiinsa Prezidaant Puutiinis injifannoo argatu jedhamee eegama. Mootummaan Ruusiyaas filannoo kana deeggarsa waraanaaf qaban agarsiisuuf kan fayyadame ta'us, yeroo filannoo kanaatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Yukreen irraa dhufeen jeequmsi uumameera. Gamtaan Awurooppaa fi mootummaan Yukreenis filannoon naannolee qabaman keessatti geggeeffame seeraan alaa dha jechuun balaaleeffataniiru.

title: France to summon Iran envoy after language centre closure in Tehran
english: France is planning to summon the Iranian ambassador in Paris following the sudden closure of a French-language school in Tehran. Iranian officials claim the center was involved in illegal activities and networking with the country's elite, while France insists the move is unjustified. This incident follows recent tensions between the two nations, including previous disputes regarding French embassy staff.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በቴህራን የሚገኝ የፈረንሳይኛ ቋንቋ ማዕከል መዘጋቱን ተከትሎ የኢራንን አምባሳደር በፓሪስ ለመጥራት ወስናለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ማዕከሉ ህገ-ወጥ ስራዎችን ሲያከናውን ነበር ሲሉ ቢከሱም፣ ፈረንሳይ ግን ይህ ድርጊት ተቀባይነት የሌለው እና ፍትሃዊ ያልሆነ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ቀደም ሲል ከነበሩት የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረቶች ጋር ተዳምሮ ግንኙነታቸውን የበለጠ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Faransaayiin magaalaa Teheraanii keessatti mana barumsaa afaan Faransaayii cufamuu isaatiin walqabatee ambaasaaddara Iraan kan Paariis jiru waamuuf murteessiteetti. Aangeyyoonni Iraan, mana barumsichaa kun hojii seeraan alaa fi qondaaltota biyyattii waliin walqunnamtii dhoksaa uumaa akka ture himatu; Faransaayiin garuu tarkaanfichi kan hin fudhatamnee fi haqa kan hin qabne dha jetteetti. Walitti buutiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti jiru kan caalaatti jabeessu ta'ee mul'ata.

title: Blasts rock town in Syria's Aleppo
english: Several strong explosions occurred in the Syrian town of al-Eis, located within the Aleppo region, early on Monday morning. State media confirmed the incident, though no specific details regarding the origin of the blasts have been released. Authorities are currently working to determine what triggered the explosions.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በሶሪያ አሌፖ ግዛት በሚገኘው አል-ኢስ ከተማ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች ተከስተዋል። የመንግስት ሚዲያዎች የፍንዳታውን መከሰት ያረጋገጡ ቢሆንም፣ የደረሱበትን ምክንያት እስካሁን ማወቅ አልተቻለም። ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dilbata gara Wiixataatti ganama garaa barii magaalaa al-Eis kanneen jedhamtu, kan Soriyaa kutaa Aleppo keessatti argamtu keessatti dhoohaan guddaan tokko mudateera. Miidiyaan mootummaa dhimma kana mirkaneesseus, sababa dhoohichaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaa ibsi ifa ta'e hin laatame. Qaamoleen mootummaa dhimma kana ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: ‘I'm so, so sorry’: Ed Sheeran addresses Gaza on stage after losing every opening act
english: Ed Sheeran publicly apologized after removing rapper Macklemore from his tour following pressure from stadium owner Robert Kraft regarding Macklemore's pro-Palestine views. During his performance in Philadelphia, Sheeran expressed regret for his difficult decisions and labeled the ongoing war in Gaza as unjustifiable and catastrophic. The concert schedule was significantly delayed because Sheeran had to perform alone after all his opening acts were withdrawn.
amharic: ኤድ ሺራን ራፐር ማክለሞርን ከኮንሰርቱ የሰረዘው ስታዲየሙ ባለቤት በነበረው ጫና ምክንያት መሆኑን ተከትሎ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። በፊላደልፊያ ባደረገው ትርኢት ወቅት፣ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ተቀባይነት የሌለው እና አሰቃቂ ሲል ገልጾ፣ በወሰዳቸው ውሳኔዎች መጸጸቱን ተናግሯል። ሌሎች የሙዚቃ አቅራቢዎች በመሰረዛቸው ምክንያት የኮንሰርቱ ሰዓት ተራዝሞ ዘፋኙ ብቻውን ለመዘፈን ተገዷል።
oromo: Ed Sheeran raapera Macklemore jedhamu qophii isaa keessaa erga baasee booda dhiifama gaafateera; kunis kan ta'e abbaan istaadiyamichaa Robert Kraft, yaada Macklemore kan Falasxiin deggaru irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeefi. Sheeran qophii Filadeelfiyaa irratti, waraanni Gazaarra jiru fudhatama kan hin qabneefi balaa hamaa kan geessise ta'uu ibsuun, murtoo isaatti gaabbuu isaa ibseera. Qophiiwwan baneen hundi waan haqamaniif, Sheeran kophaasaa hojjachuun isaa qophiin kun yeroo dheeraaf akka ture taasiseera.

title: Israeli forces wound Palestinian woman and two children in Gaza
english: Israeli military operations across Gaza have resulted in injuries to a woman and two children. According to local reports, the victims were hurt in separate incidents involving gunfire and a drone strike. Additionally, naval forces targeted fishermen working off the coast of central Gaza.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች አንዲት ሴትና ሁለት ህፃናት ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በአካባቢው ምንጮች መረጃ መሰረት፣ ተጎጂዎቹ በጥይት እና በድሮን ጥቃት የተጎዱ ሲሆን በተጨማሪም የባህር ኃይል ሃይሎች በመካከለኛው ጋዛ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ የነበሩ አሳ አጥማጆች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoo gara garaa Gaazaatti bananiin dubartii tokko fi ijoollee lama miidhaan irra ga'eera. Gabaasni naannichaa akka ibsutti, miidhaan kun kan ga'e dhukaasaa fi haleellaa xiyyaara nama maleen (drone) yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin immoo qarqara galaana Gaazaa giddu galeessatti qabattoo (fish) qabattota irratti haleellaan banameera.

title: Houthis declare 'blockade for blockade' on Saudi, assure US ships are safe
english: The Houthi movement has announced a strategy of 'blockade for blockade' against Saudi Arabia, vowing to challenge Saudi restrictions by targeting their ships in the Red Sea. Despite this aggression, the group has assured the United States that American vessels remain safe and will not be attacked. Their primary goal remains ending the Saudi-led campaign to restore Yemeni infrastructure and secure national economic resources.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚጥሉትን እገዳ ለመበቀል በባህር ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ የሳውዲ መርከቦችን ኢላማ እንደሚያደርግ ቢገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ መርከቦች ግን ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ እንደሆነ ማረጋገጫ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በየመን ላይ የሚደረገውን ዘመቻ ለማስቆም እና የሀገሪቱን ወደቦችና የኢኮኖሚ ሀብቶች ለመመለስ ታስቦ ነው።
oromo: Houthiinis Saudii Arabiyaa irratti ukkammii isaanii deebisuuf jechuun markaboota isaanii galaana diimaa irratti akka miidhan akeekkachiisaniiru. Gareen kun Saudi Arabiyaa qofa kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, markaboonni Ameerikaa garuu nagaa akka ta'an mirkaneessaniiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan duula Saudiin Yemen irratti gaggeessitu dhaabsisuufi qabeenya biyyattii deebifachuudha.

title: Trump administration prepares to sanction ICC, WSJ reports
english: President Donald Trump is moving to penalize the International Criminal Court following its decision to issue arrest warrants for senior Israeli officials. According to reports, the administration will soon restrict financial transactions with the court after a short transition period. These sanctions were ordered shortly after Trump took office to retaliate against the court's war crimes investigation involving Gaza.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከፍተኛ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የአለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት የእስር ትእዛዝ ማውጣቱን ተከትሎ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያሳዩት መንግስታቸው የፍርድ ቤቱን የገንዘብ ልውውጦች ለመገደብ ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በፍልስጤም ጋዛ ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጦርነቶችን በሚመለከት ፍርድ ቤቱ እያካሄደ ያለውን ምርመራ ለመቃወም ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp hoogganoota Israa'eel irratti ajaja hidhaa waan baaseef, Manni Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa (ICC) irratti tarkaanfii adabbii fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, mootummaan isaa guyyoota muraasa booda walta'iinsa maallaqaa mana murtiichaa wajjin jiru akka dhorguuf murteesseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, mana murtichi yakka waraanaa Gaazaarratti raawwatame jedhu qorachuu isaa mormuufidha.

title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
english: An 82-year-old man died after a violent dispute over a sunlounger at a beach near Athens, Greece. The altercation involved a 76-year-old man who has since been arrested by local authorities. Emergency responders attempted to save the victim with CPR, but he unfortunately passed away after being transported to the hospital.
amharic: ግሪክ አቴንስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በፀሐይ መታጠቢያ ወንበር ምክንያት በተፈጠረ ግጭት የ82 ዓመት አዛውንት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው ከ76 ዓመት አዛውንት ጋር ሲሆን፣ ግለሰቡ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የድንገተኛ ህክምና ባለሙያዎች የአዛውንቱን ህይወት ለማትረፍ ጥረት ቢያደርጉም ወደ ሆስፒታል ካመሩ በኋላ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Giriikitti bakka bishaan daakuu tokkotti, namni umuriin isaa 82 ta'e tokko garaagarummaa teessoo aduutti fayyadamuu irratti uumameen du'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun nama umuriin isaa 76 ta'e waliin kan uumame yoo ta'u, namichi kunis poolisiin qabameera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa lubbuu namichaa oolchuuf carraaqqii godhanis, gara hospitaalaatti erga geessamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera.

title: Qatar PM urges Gulf security framework with Iran
english: Qatar's Prime Minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, is calling for a formal security agreement between Gulf nations and Iran. He stated that regional stability depends on creating a framework where countries no longer view one another as threats. This proposal aims to move beyond current tensions to foster better diplomatic relations throughout the region.
amharic: የቀጣሩ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልረህማን አል ታኒ በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት እና በኢራን መካከል የጸጥታ ስምምነት እንዲኖር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የቀጣናው መረጋጋት የሚመጣው አገራት እርስ በርስ ስጋት እንደማይፈጥሩ የሚያረጋግጥ ማዕቀፍ ሲኖር ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ሃሳብ አሁን ካለው ውጥረት በመውጣት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የተሻለ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, biyyoota Gulf fi Iran gidduutti waligaltee nageenyaa akka uumamuu qabu gaafataniiru. Nagaan naannichaa kan mirkanaa'uu danda'u, biyyoonni walii walii isaanii sodaachisaa akka hin taane kan mirkaneessu sirni yoo uumame qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Dhiheenyi kun walitti bu'iinsa ammaa furuun hariiroo dippilomaasii naannicha keessatti fooyyessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Argentina’s Left stages ‘March of Anger’ over Milei’s austerity measures
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Buenos Aires for a 'March of Anger' to protest against the severe economic austerity measures introduced by Argentina's government. Left-wing groups led the demonstration, arguing that the recent budget cuts are significantly harming working-class families. The participants expressed their strong opposition to the administration's current financial policies through these widespread public rallies.
amharic: በአርጀንቲና የዋጋ ቅነሳ እርምጃዎችን በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች በቦነስ አይረስ የቁጣ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። በግራ ዘመም ቡድኖች የተመራው ይህ ሰልፍ የመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች በሰራተኛ ቤተሰቦች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያሳደሩ መሆኑን ለመግለጽ የታለመ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በመንግስት እየተወሰዱ ያሉ የቁጠባ እርምጃዎች የኑሮ ሁኔታን እየጎዱ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ ቅሬታቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Arjantiinaa keessatti hiriirtonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhate mormuun magaalaa Buwonos Ayiresitti 'Hiriira Aarii' gaggeessaniiru. Gareewwan gara bitaatti kan hidhatan hiriira kana durfaniiru; isaanis murteen mootummaan baajata irratti godhe maatiiwwan hojjettootaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jira jedhanii mormaniiru. Hiriirtonni kun siyaasa dinagdee mootummaan ammaa hordofaa jiru irratti mormii cimaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Eighteen suspects extradited to US over Haitian president’s 2021 killing
english: Eighteen suspects have been transferred from Haiti to Florida to face trial for their alleged roles in the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse. This move represents a significant step in the ongoing U.S. federal investigation into the transnational conspiracy that led to the leader's death. Officials emphasized their commitment to pursuing justice against everyone involved in funding or carrying out the plot, noting that further legal actions are expected.

Shakkamtoonni kun ajjeechaa kana keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin dhaabbata mana murtii federaalaa Folooridaatti dhiyaachuuf jiru. Abbootiin alangaa Ameerikaa ajjeechaa kana kan karoorfanii fi maallaqa itti dhangalaasan hundaa seeraatti dhiyeessuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Qatar PM describes fallout of US-Israel war on Iran as ‘earthquake’
english: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani has warned that the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran is causing severe regional and global instability, which he likened to an earthquake. He emphasized that lasting security in the Middle East requires mutual respect for national sovereignty and a commitment to addressing the root causes of regional tensions. In response to these challenges, Qatar announced a $38 billion domestic infrastructure investment plan to boost its economic resilience.

Nageenyi idil-addunyaa fi naannichaa akka mirkanaa'uuf, biyyoonni tokko kan biraa kabajuu fi madda waraanaa kanaa furuun akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru. Rakkoo kana dandamachuufis, Qatar dinagdee ishee cimsuuf sagantaa ijaarsa bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyya keessaa kan dolaara biiliyoona 38 ta'u ifoomsiteetti.

title: US, China open high-level talks ahead of Trump-Xi summit
english: Top economic officials from the US and China have begun high-level discussions in New York to prepare for a meeting between President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping later this week. The talks focus on addressing trade tensions, including a potential extension of a trade truce and concerns over the supply of critical minerals. Additionally, the representatives are exploring collaborative safety standards for artificial intelligence to mitigate global security risks.

title: How will Saudi Arabia deal with the Houthis?
english: Violent confrontations have escalated between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen for the first time since the 2022 ceasefire. The Houthis recently launched missiles toward Riyadh, warning that any further military pressure will be met with stronger retaliatory strikes. This growing tension creates significant concern that the regional instability could worsen and draw other neighboring nations into the conflict.

title: Man Utd salvage Fulham draw as pressure mounts on Carrick
english: Manchester United managed to secure a 1-1 draw against Fulham following a late goal by Matheus Cunha, avoiding a third consecutive loss. Despite the result, the team's poor performance has increased the pressure on manager Michael Carrick, who is currently struggling to produce consistent results. With only one win in their last five league matches, the club is falling behind their competitors, leaving the manager’s future under intense public scrutiny.

title: Gaza artists honour Macklemore for supporting Palestine
english: Artists living in Gaza are creating murals on the ruins of destroyed buildings to express their gratitude toward American rapper Macklemore. They are honoring the musician for his vocal advocacy and public support for the Palestinian cause. This artistic tribute comes as the region continues to endure ongoing military strikes and violence.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel pardons soldier Elor Azaria
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has granted a pardon to Elor Azaria, a former soldier previously convicted for the 2016 killing of an incapacitated Palestinian man. This decision comes as many Jewish Israelis gather at the Western Wall for prayers leading up to the Yom Kippur holiday. The news of the pardon has emerged alongside various international updates reported by Al Jazeera.

title: Trump tariffs hit Canada’s dairy farmers as US sales stall
english: Canadian dairy farmers are facing significant challenges after the United States imposed a 50 percent tariff on their products in August. This trade barrier has severely reduced demand, leaving producers struggling to find new markets for their excess supply. Farmers warn that if the situation does not stabilize, they may be forced to discard milk or downsize their herds because production cannot be easily halted.

title: Central Colombia forest fire threatens tourist town of Villa de Leyva
english: A large wildfire is currently burning in the hills near the popular tourist destination of Villa de Leyva in central Colombia. The government has mobilized aircraft, military helicopters, and specialized firefighting teams from across the country to protect the historical town from the spreading flames. This incident is part of a broader national crisis, as extreme drought and high temperatures driven by the El Nino weather pattern have sparked multiple fires throughout the region.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ኮሎምቢያ በሚገኘው ታዋቂው የቱሪስት ከተማ ቪላ ደ ሌይቫ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። መንግስት ታሪካዊቷን ከተማ ከእሳት አደጋ ለመከላከል የአውሮፕላን ድጋፍ፣ የወታደራዊ ሄሊኮፕተሮችን እና ተጨማሪ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞችን ወደ ስፍራው ልኳል። ይህ አደጋ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የተከሰቱ በርካታ የእሳት አደጋዎች አካል ሲሆን፣ በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ድርቅ እና ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ሁኔታውን አባብሶታል።
oromo: Koolombiyaa giddu galeessaatti, magaalaa tuuristii bekamtuu Villa de Leyva jedhamtu biratti ibidni bosonaa guddaan ka'ee jira. Mootummaan magaalaa seena qabeettii tana balaa kana irraa oolchuuf xiyyaarota, helikopteroota waraanaa fi garee dhaamsitoota ibiddaa biyyattii irraa walitti babbahan gara sana ergeera. Balaan kun rakkoo biyyaalessaa kanneen biroo wajjin wal qabatu yoo ta'u, jijjiiramni qilleensaa fi sababa El Nino'n ho'inni cimaan fi gogiinsi uumame ibidda kana babal'isaa jira.

title: Atletico Madrid beat 10-man Real Madrid 2-1 in feisty La Liga derby
english: Atletico Madrid defeated a ten-man Real Madrid 2-1 in a tense La Liga derby. The turning point occurred early in the second half when Dean Huijsen was red-carded for a foul, allowing Alejandro Grimaldo to score from the resulting penalty. Jonathan David added a second goal for Atletico, and despite a late effort from Antonio Rudiger, Real Madrid fell to their second defeat of the season.
amharic: አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ በአስር ተጫዋቾች በተገደበው ሪያል ማድሪድ ላይ በላ ሊጋው የደርቢ ጨዋታ 2 ለ 1 አሸንፏል። የጨዋታው መለያ ነጥብ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ መጀመሪያ ላይ ዲን ሁይሰን በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ አሌሃንድሮ ግሪማልዶ በፍጹም ቅጣት ምት ግብ ማስቆጠሩ ነው። ጆናታን ዴቪድ ለአትሌቲኮ ሁለተኛዋን ግብ ያስቆጠረ ሲሆን፣ አንቶኒዮ ሩዲገርም ለሪያል ማድሪድ አንድ ግብ ቢመልስም ቡድኑ በውድድር ዘመኑ ሁለተኛ ሽንፈቱን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Atleetikoon Maadriid garee Real Maadriid taphataa tokko hir’ate 2-1n mo’achuun danda’eera. Murtii game-ichaa kan jijjiire yeroo Dean Huijsen kaardiin diimaa ba’uun isaa fi Alejandro Grimaldo pheenaltii argame fayyadamuun goolii jalqabaa galchuun isaa ture. Jonathan David goolii lammaffaa Atleetikootiif galcheera; Antonio Rudiger xumura irratti goolii tokko galchullee, Real Maadriid injifannoo argachuu dadhabee yeroo lammaffaaf mo’atameera.

title: Photos: Nepal flood survivors find little trace of former lives
english: Devastating flash floods and mudslides in Nepal, triggered by a glacial collapse, have killed over 1,300 people and left thousands missing. Survivors returning to their homes in areas like Betrawati are finding nothing but debris, with many families losing both their loved ones and their land. This catastrophe has left the affected communities struggling to cope, as the total destruction has erased not only their homes but their sense of future security.
amharic: በኔፓል በተከሰተ የበረዶ ግግር መደርመስ ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ጎርፍና የመሬት መንሸራተት ከ1,300 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችንም አጠፋፍቷል። ቤታቸው ወደተመለሱት ተጎጂዎች ስንመለከት፣ ቤታቸው በደለል ተቀብሮና ንብረታቸውም ወድሞ አግኝተውታል። ይህ ከፍተኛ አደጋ ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን ከማፈናቀሉም በላይ የኑሮ መሰረታቸውን በማውደሙ ለወደፊቱ ያላቸውን ተስፋ አጨልሞታል።
oromo: Neepaal keessatti balaa cabiinsa caba caba (glacial collapse) irraa ka'een lolaa fi manca'iinsi lafaa namoota 1,300 ol ajjeesee, kumaatamaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo akka badanii fi maqaan isaanii hin beekamne godheera. Namoonni balaa kanaan miidhaman gara mana isaanii deebi'an, manni isaanii dhoqqee fi manca'iinsaan uwwifamee waan argataniif, qabeenyaa fi jaallatamoota isaanii dhabuun isaanii isaan miidheera. Balaan kun jireenya jiraattotaa guutummaatti kan diige yoo ta'u, dhaloota dhufuufis abdii kan kutachiise ta'uun ibsameera.
